vector x on P.32+33 (Quantitative Corpus Linguistics with R).

When I type the text: <C:/_qclwr/inputfiles/dat_vector-a.txt in R, I
get the following message:

Error: unexpected input in "C:\"

When I look at my C drive for the input files, I see the following:

C:\_qclwr\_inputfiles\_inputfiles

(this is where dat_vector-a.txt file is stored after unzipping the
inputfiles. I am able to 1,2,3 as a text file but not in R)

I was wondering what I was doing wrong..

I will be glad if anyone can help.

Seza

I worked it out...for some reason, there was another input file inside the input file under C

so, the path looked  like:C:\_qclwr\_inputfiles\_inputfiles

I made it one file again C:\_qclwr\_inputfiles

Secondly, I was literally following the command <c:/_qclwr/_inputfiles/dat_vector-a.txt> (bottom of page 31) but did not put an argument in it (scan)

After doing these changes, it works fine...I will go further with it...

Thank you for help anyway,
Seza
